Create realistic production-quality UI designs with strong, precise typography and intentional spacing for CouncilKit, a Chinese local-first multi-agent review desktop app. Use-case ui-mockup. ONE focused primary desktop screen, dimensions 1440x1024. App content only: no browser chrome, no desktop wallpaper, no floating app card, no mock device, no concept label outside the app. This is an exploratory layout direction, NOT final implementation.
Reference roles: supplied real Linear/GitHub/Sentry product images are references for density, fixed headers, alignment and master-detail structure ONLY. Don't copy their logos, actual content, diff-editing features or data metrics. Supplied CouncilKit v2 is brand/context reference and example of the overlarge headers and sparsity we want to improve, NOT a pixel-match target.
VISUAL: genuinely compact mature productivity tool. Flat neutral charcoal surfaces, warmer and less blue than v2: app #17181a; global nav #101113; context nav #131416; surface #202124; divider #292a2d. Text #e4e5e7; secondary #96999f; subdued brass #bca37c as tiny selected underline/marker, NOT big gold buttons or yellow text. Green only a 5px completion dot, all status text neutral. Blue small running dot, no large bright circles or spinners. No gradients, glow, texture, grain, translucent pseudo-depth or screenshot vignettes. Borders only for essential region boundaries; use spacing/alignment instead of boxed cards.
Typography: Chinese system sans + restrained monospace for code. Utility labels 13px/20px, primary UI labels14px, report body16px/26px, section headings17px/26px medium, report title24px/32px semibold. Do not oversize to fill screen! 16px icons, thin strokes, mostly muted. Maintain readable density. Copy/open PR are secondary ghost controls, not a large primary action. Primary content starts ABOVE y200, not halfway down page. No big red verdict.
DATA shared across all concepts: current date2026-09-20, demo PR "piston #413" SHA6424bc1; review still running, 3/5 seats finished; 安全审查 completed8m29s, 正确性审查 completed5m56s, 对抗审查 completed15m47s, 可维护性审查 running, 兼容性审查 running; Aggregator waiting. Selected report seat is 对抗审查. Seat has durable original report but no structured verdict or finding count; show neutral "席位原文 · 暂无结构化摘要". No issues totals, passed/needs-changes badge, no invented verification. Tiny "演示数据" metadata. No fake progress%/ETA/token-cost charts. Existing features only.

Title "重连与消息重放审查"
Section "审查范围"
"本次检查覆盖事件重放、断线恢复与消息合并，重点关注重连前后的内容一致性。"
Section "观察与分析"
"连接恢复后，历史片段会重新进入消息合并逻辑。需要结合事件序号与当前消息状态，判断已完成正文是否被再次追加。"
"现有测试覆盖了顺序到达的事件，但混合历史重放与空文本完成帧仍值得补充验证。"
Small two-line mono block:
"首次接收 → 完成消息"
"断线重连 → 重放历史 → 检查正文一致性"
Section "建议验证"
"1. 重放相同历史，确认正文不会重复。"
"2. 接收空文本完成帧后重连，确认内容仍保留。"
"3. 模拟连续断线，观察重连请求是否收敛。"
